{{short description|Russian mathematician (born 1939)}}
'''Yuri Petrovich Ofman''' ({{langx|ru|Ю́рий Петро́вич Офман}}, born 1939) is a [[Russian people|Russian]] [[mathematician]] who works in [[computational complexity theory]].

He obtained his [[Ph.D.|Doctorate]] from [[Moscow State University]], where he was advised by [[Andrey Kolmogorov]].<ref name=magen>{{MathGenealogy|17532}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/mathscinet/search/author.html?mrauthid=510897&Submit=Search|title=Ofman, Ju.|url-access=subscription |work=[[MathSciNet]]|access-date=2018-01-20}}</ref>
He did important early work on [[parallel algorithm]]s for [[prefix sum]]s and their application in the design of [[adder (electronics)|Boolean circuits for addition]].

== Publications ==
* {{cite journal| year=1963 | title=О приближенной реализации непрерывных функций на автоматах |trans-title=On the approximate realization of continuous functions on automata | journal=[[Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR]] | volume=152 | issue=4 | pages=823–826}}
* {{cite journal| year=1962 | title=Об алгоритмической сложности дискретных функций |trans-title=On the algorithmic complexity of discrete functions | journal=Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR | volume=145 | issue=1 | pages=48–51}} Translated in {{cite journal| journal=Soviet Physics Doklady | volume=7 | page=589|title=none}}
* Anatolii A. Karatsuba and Yu. P. Ofman (1962), "Умножение многозначных чисел на автоматах" ("Multiplication of Many-Digital Numbers by Automatic Computers"), ''Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR'', vol. 146, pages 293–294. (Published by A. N. Kolmogorov, with two separate results by the two authors.<ref name=gri2012>S. A. Gricenko, E. A. Karatsuba, M. A. Korolyov, I. S. Rezvyakova, D. I. Tolev, and M. E. Changa  (2012). "Научные достижения Анатолия Алексеевича Карацубы" ("Scientific contributions of A. A. Karatsuba"). ''Современные проблемы математики'', volume 16, issue 0, pages 7-30.</ref>)
* Yu. P. Ofman (1965), "A universal automaton". ''Transactions of the Moscow Mathemathematical Society'', volume 14, pages 200–215.
